title: The challenge
text: In 2025, the world burned 167 billion cubic meters of gas through flaring: an estimated 54 billion dollars in wasted value. This is also a community issue. A study in Eagle Ford associated high nearby flaring with fifty percent higher odds of preterm birth. Operators face a practical question: with limited capital, which flares should they fix first? FlareWise connects that investment decision to the people downwind. Recovering gas creates a financial reason to act; targeting the right sources makes community priorities part of the investment case.

title: A better investment decision
text: Our users are operator capital teams, working with health, safety and environment teams and public-health planners. In South Texas, we evaluate 392 candidates using gas volumes, economics, hourly winds and real Census demographics. Give us ten million dollars. Financial delivers 33.6 million in projected seven-year net present value and a 5.2 percent reduction in our population-weighted exposure index. Now switch to Balanced: retain 95.5 percent of financial value while more than doubling that index improvement to 10.6 percent. Community prioritization reaches 22.2 percent. The creative step is making these competing priorities one explicit, inspectable investment decision.

title: Working technology
text: Underneath, integer optimization selects actual projects within budget. Annual analysis uses every hour of weather, while Census attribution shows which tracts benefit. This interactive three-dimensional replay follows moving emissions. Compare capture installed at ten p.m.: new emissions shrink while previously emitted material continues downwind. GPU-instanced rendering delivered about sixty frames per second in our local test. We also trained a twelve-band Sentinel-2 U-Net for industrial-smoke segmentation. On 374 held-out images, its intersection-over-union reached 47.1 percent, versus 23.6 percent for a simple RGB heuristic. These are saved predictions and a reproducible model. Forty-one tests verify the build.

title: From pilot to scale
text: TotalEnergies has committed to ending routine flaring by 2030. FlareWise could help turn that commitment into a prioritized project pipeline. Our proposed first pilot pairs one asset team's engineering costs and infrastructure constraints with local environmental validation. Success means a shortlist ready for engineering review, with economics and community priorities assessed together. We would measure recovered gas, project returns and independently verified emissions changes. Then expand basin by basin through regional weather, population and infrastructure data. Our global inventory already provides discovery across 77 countries. Our vision is a new standard for climate investment: every dollar evaluated for both economic return and the communities it can benefit. FlareWise makes that future actionable.
